zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_config_help: 将下面的插件配置合并到你实际使用的DSH profile配置中，保留已有插件与角色设置。启动或重新加载后，开启八三的四个工具。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_copy_failed: 复制失败，请手动选中并复制配置。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_intro: 查询八三菜单、价格与月售，记住自己的菜品偏好和备注。用邮箱验证码建立独立食堂档案；在不同客户端用同一邮箱连接，可以继续使用原来的记录。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_invalid_code: 验证码错误、已使用或已过期，请检查或重新获取。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_invalid_input: 请检查邮箱、六位验证码和连接名称。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_key_help: 为自己使用的客户端生成连接凭据。凭据只在生成时显示，请保存配置；遗失后可以重新验证邮箱并生成新的凭据。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_login: 验证邮箱，保存自己的口味
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_login_help: 邮箱验证用于保存个人喜好
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_mail_failed: 验证码发送失败，请稍后重试。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_mail_unavailable: 邮箱验证暂未开放，请稍后再试。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_private_connection: 这份连接使用你的个人食堂档案，请只接到自己使用的AI里，不要分享凭据。多人共用的公共机器人不在此接入方式内。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_qq_help: 如果你的QQ AI使用DeepSeek Harness和dsh-qqbot，把上面的八三插件添加到QQ机器人正在使用的同一个profile，并确保QQ角色也启用了这些工具。无需重新注册QQ机器人，也不需要更换角色。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_qq_title: 在你已有的QQ AI里使用
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_revoke: 撤销全部连接凭据（保留偏好和备注）
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_revoked: 连接凭据已撤销，偏好和备注仍然保留。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_sent: 验证码已发送，10分钟内有效。一分钟后可以重新发送。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_sign_in_again: 请重新验证邮箱后继续。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_snapshot: 菜单为保存的快照，价格和月售以采集时信息为准。暂不支持下单或付款。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_try: 连接后可以试着说：“看看八三有哪些面？”“这道菜我很喜欢，帮我记下来。”以后换聊天仍可查询已保存的评价。
zh-Hans.com_canteen_public_wait: 请在上次发送一分钟后重新获取验证码。

en.com_canteen_public_config_help: Merge this plugin entry into the DSH profile you use, keeping existing plugins and character settings. Start or reload it, then enable all four Basan tools.
en.com_canteen_public_copy_failed: Copy failed. Select and copy the configuration manually.
en.com_canteen_public_intro: Browse the Basan menu, prices and monthly sales, and save your own preferences and dish notes. Verify your email to create an independent food profile. Use the same email across clients to keep your records.
en.com_canteen_public_invalid_code: The code is incorrect, used or expired. Check it or request a new code.
en.com_canteen_public_invalid_input: Check your email, six-digit code and connection name.
en.com_canteen_public_key_help: Generate a credential for your own client. It is shown only when generated, so save the configuration. If lost, verify your email again and create another credential.
en.com_canteen_public_login: Verify your email to save your tastes
en.com_canteen_public_login_help: Email verification is used to save your personal preferences.
en.com_canteen_public_mail_failed: The verification email could not be sent. Please try again later.
en.com_canteen_public_mail_unavailable: Email verification is not available yet. Please try again later.
en.com_canteen_public_private_connection: This connection uses your personal food profile. Connect only to an AI you use yourself and keep the credential private. This setup does not cover shared public bots.
en.com_canteen_public_qq_help: If your QQ AI uses DeepSeek Harness with dsh-qqbot, add this Basan plugin to the same profile as the QQ bot and enable its tools for the QQ character. Keep your existing bot and character.
en.com_canteen_public_revoke: Revoke all connection credentials (keep preferences and notes)
en.com_canteen_public_revoked: Connection credentials were revoked. Your preferences and notes are still saved.
en.com_canteen_public_sent: Code sent. It is valid for 10 minutes. You can request another after one minute.
en.com_canteen_public_sign_in_again: Verify your email again to continue.
en.com_canteen_public_snapshot: This is a saved menu snapshot. Prices and sales reflect the capture date. Ordering and payment are not supported.
en.com_canteen_public_try: Try asking: “What noodles are on the Basan menu?” or “I really like this dish; remember that.” Your saved feedback remains available in later chats.
en.com_canteen_public_wait: Wait one minute after the last email before requesting another code.
en.com_relay_action_failed: The action could not be completed. Refresh the status and try again; sending the same draft again reuses its message key.
